text:
amy: heads up — deploybot blocked the staging->canary publish to eu-north-1 because mirrored replicas have conflicting provenance stamps. holding the window.
josh: paste the error?
amy: from deploybot:

```
> deploybot: publish blocked repo=redwood/runtime:staging-20260410 -> eu-north-1/canary
> cause: provenance annotation conflict across replicas: 'ci_stamp' differs (stamp-432 vs stamp-431)
> enforcement: deny_publish_to_prevent_ambiguous_tag
```

priya: are the artifact digests different or just the labels?
amy: digests identical, only the ci_stamp differs. looks like our labeler retried and stamped twice.
nate: safe path = promote the already-verified digest instead of republishing a new image. avoids churn.
josh: agree. policy allows manual pin on matching digest if we log an exception and file a follow-up bug.
amy: proposed plan: 1) pause automated publish, 2) manual promote digest sha256:feedc0de1234 to eu-north-1 canary via deploybot, 3) add changelog note about manual pin, 4) open ticket INF-4412 to fix labeler dedupe.
priya: I can add the release-note line. nate: I'll prep rollback runbook: revert to sha256:badc0ffee999 if error rate >1% for 5m or new crashloop spikes.
amy: initiating manual promote now. deploybot requires 2 approvers due to change-window.
deploybot: manual promote request: `promote --digest sha256:feedc0de1234 --target eu-north-1/canary`
deploybot: approval_required: 2 approvers from eng-releases or release-manager.
change-window-bot: change-window open until 13:10 UTC. ack here to proceed; oncall will temporarily allow this digest promote.
josh: ack
priya: ack — adding release-note: "Canary promoted to sha256:feedc0de1234 after automated publish was blocked due to divergent provenance stamps; no rebuild performed."
deploybot: approvals received from josh, priya. promoting sha256:feedc0de1234 -> eu-north-1/canary. promote complete. exception ticket INF-4412 created.
amy: manual promote done. monitoring for 15m. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
